text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"The Kawasaki Ninja H2 is a leading candidate for India's fastest production motorcycle.","cited_pids":["e3effe5ed347#2","e3effe5ed347#3"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"The Kawasaki Ninja H2R reaches nearly 400 km/h.","cited_pids":["5bab82194822#2"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"The Kawasaki Ninja H2R is track-only and not road-legal in India.","cited_pids":["0d96b47079bb#1"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"The Ducati Panigale V4 R is described as exceeding 330 km/h with a race exhaust.","cited_pids":["5bab82194822#5","5bab82194822#2"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"The Kawasaki Ninja H2 SX SE is listed with a 330 km/h top speed.","cited_pids":["0618079a2be5#0"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"The BMW M 1000 RR is homologated to about 314 km/h.","cited_pids":["5bab82194822#6"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"Many superbikes are cited as electronically limited to a 299 km/h top speed.","cited_pids":["0618079a2be5#1"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"The Kawasaki Ninja H2R is the fastest production motorcycle overall.","cited_pids":[]},{"cid":"c9","text":"Among road-legal bikes, the Ducati Panigale V4 R or Kawasaki Ninja H2 are the leading contenders for fastest.","cited_pids":[]}]}
